tools.name: start_checkout
tools.description: Reserve tickets for a buyer and get a secure payment link. Only call after the user has confirmed the event, ticket types, quantities, and their name and email. No payment is taken until the user completes the checkoutUrl; tickets are held briefly and emailed to the buyer after payment.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_event, start_checkout · Public sink: start_checkout.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_event, start_checkout · Public sink: start_checkout

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
